If you are not improving in 3 days time, we will return your money including room rent and food, what else we can do for you?   In a week time you will get considerable relief and within 2 to 3 weeks in more than 90% cases your pain, swelling, bulging, stiffness etc… will go and you will get back mobility and flexibility. Our challenging offer

If you believe that your Spondylosis is not curable, come to us, we will cure you. You can even pay after getting the result (no need to pay in the beginning of treatment) for more details regarding this offer visit our challenging offer page.

Treatment

Our spondylosis treatment is divided in to two parts, panchakarma (detoxification) therapy plus internal and external medicine. We use different Panchakarma techniques like massage, Elakizhi, Njavara Kizhi/Payasam, Vasthi, Pichu, Nasyam, Virechana, Medicated Steam bath etc.. as per the severity and requirement of the patient. to remove the toxins, swelling, stiffness and bulging. We are using special Ayurvedic medicines for this purpose.  We are treating Spondylosis for generations, and accumulated knowledge and experience that we gained, helps us to give the best treatment to our patients. The treatments and medicines vary according to the severity and the condition of the patient. Normally we are giving 21 days detoxification therapy, rare cases it may take few more days, it all depends on the problem, age of the patient, how long he/she is suffering from, the size of bulging and stiffness etc… The patient must come personally and undergo this treatment.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Spondylosis. We have our own special medicines as well for internal and external use. Medicines vary with the condition of the patient. We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We use quality materials for the manufacture of these quality medicines.

 Benefits of our treatment

  1. Normally patients will get some relaxation and pain will come down, in most cases they can leave the painkiller in the first day of our treatment itself.   Normally with in 2 or 3 days they will feel much better and relaxed.
  2. More than 90% people will not feel any more pain within 2-3 weeks time.  Others may take some more time.
  3. Our treatment is free from side effects.
  4. In our treatment there is no risky operation, or painful therapy  or like that.  It is 100% safe and protects your health.
  5. Sometimes patients are get operated, in that case it gives some relief temporarily, The pain continue to increase, you will become helpless.  If you comes to us you can avoid it and you can do the normal life after our treatment.
  6. Our medications for Spondylosis  will help to remove toxins, inflammation, stiffness, bulging etc… and release the nerve if it is compressed.
  7. Once the stiffness and bulging is over, the nerve will be released and you will not feel pain. The gap between discs will also be adjusted automatically.  Earlier the stiffness and bulging doesn’t allow the spinal cord to keep the discs in the normal way.
  8. Our treatment increase the blood supply in the affected parts and the cells will get more oxygen and nutrients and this helps to rebuild the degenerated parts, and stops further degeneration.
  9. Our treatments and medicines helps to remove the side effects of medicines you have taken earlier.

Duration of the treatment

Normally the patient have to undergo the therapy for three weeks, rare cases it may take some more time. The speed of recovery and duration of the treatment depends on many factors including the severity of the problem, the age of the patient,  how long the patient is suffering from this problem  etc..  Everybody have to continue the medications for 6 months to one year. Rare cases the duration may increase.

 What is  Cervical / Lumbar Spondylosis

Cervical / Lumbar Spondylosis is a common cause of chronic Neck pain / Back pain. The term spondylosis refers to degenerative osteoarthritis of the joints between the central of the spinal vertebrae or neural foramina. When the space between the two adjacent vertebrae narrows, the compression of a nerve root emerging from the spinal cord may result in sensory and motor disturbance such as severe pain in the neck, back, shoulder, legs and arms depends on the area where it is affected. The patients may experience shock in the hands or legs. The nerve compression leads to decrease in blood circulation in the affected area. If you go through a scan report, you can find that there is stiffness, bulging, nerve compression, narrowing of the spinal cord etc…
